verdict.rationale: Foreloop provides a Feedback list that aggregates customer submissions from the widget and lets teams create intentions/stories/tasks via CLI, giving a de facto central intake point, but the evidence never mentions search or a unified view combining colleague and customer requests in one searchable repository. missing for 10: explicit search/filtering capability, evidence that colleague-submitted requests and customer feedback live in the same queryable view, and any UI screenshot or independent report confirming a single searchable repository.
